name: rune-lang
description: Rune language support: syntax highlighting, diagnostics from the compiler and linter, code completion, hover, go to definition, references and quick fixes.

rune.server.path.markdownDescription: The program that runs the language server. Either `rune` (the toolchain driver, which is started as `rune lsp`) or `rune-lsp` itself. Empty means `rune` on `PATH`.

rune.server.extraArgs.description: Further arguments for the language server.

rune.stdlib.markdownDescription: Where the standard library is: the directory holding `std/`. Empty means the toolchain's own.

rune.checkOnSave.markdownDescription: Run the compiler when a file is opened or saved (`rune check` in a package, `runec --check` otherwise) and show its diagnostics.

rune.check.onChange.markdownDescription: Also run the compiler as you type, once typing pauses, checking unsaved files as they stand in the editor. Every error a build would report shows — type errors, the borrow checker's, macro expansion.

rune.check.delay.markdownDescription: How long typing must pause, in milliseconds, before `#rune.check.onChange#` runs the compiler.

rune.inlayHints.types.markdownDescription: Show the inferred type of each binding written without one, greyed out after its name. Double-click one to write it in.

rune.inlayHints.parameters.markdownDescription: Show the parameter each positional argument goes to, greyed out before it. Double-click one to write the label in. An argument that is already a variable of the same name gets none.

rune.check.memory.markdownDescription: The memory model a file outside any package is checked in. `zombie` shows the borrow checker's errors. Inside a package, `[build] memory` in its `Rune.toml` decides.

rune.lint.enable.description: Show the linter's findings as you type.

rune.lint.allow.markdownDescription: Lint rules to turn off, by name (`rune lint --list` names them). `all` turns every rule off. A package's `[lint]` table in `Rune.toml` applies first.

rune.lint.warn.markdownDescription: Lint rules to turn on, including the ones that are off by default, such as `missing-docs`.

rune.lint.maxLineLength.markdownDescription: The limit for `line-too-long`. `0` keeps the package's setting, or 120.

rune.trace.server.description: Log the conversation with the language server to its output channel.
